repairRequest.requestedBoundary: The actual v3 technical record distinguishes application availability from preservation of existing C Pods; the former did not exclude the full-rollout option.
repairRequest.authorResponse: After rereading the exact v3 options, explanations, technical notes and actual ConfigMap unit, selected an explicit no-restart/no-replacement rule for C’s existing Pods. Aligned the three selective actions and rationale with Pod identity rather than assuming every rollout causes downtime.

authorChanges: Explicit stem prohibition on restarting or replacing any existing C Pods, rather than merely keeping the application running.

Explanations explicitly avoid asserting that all rollouts interrupt service or that maintaining service availability preserves Pod identity.
